Definition: Tsadok, the name of eight or nine Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Zadok was the priest who stood by David when others fell away. He was the son of Ahitub, priest in David's reign and a young man of valour who came to David at Hebron; and it was Zadok who anointed Solomon king at Gihon while Adonijah feasted. The name belongs to eight or nine Israelites, but the priest son of Ahitub is the one the story remembers.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Zadok shows what faithfulness looks like in a priest — staying with God's anointed when the crowd goes another way. My position is that God honours the priest who honours God's king.
RelatedPeople: Zadok, Son of Ahitub; King David; King Solomon
